title: 第一章
slug: 娇软妹宝随军后禁欲军官沦陷了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

秋收季，正值中午。

几个妇女忙里偷闲，讨论前来送饭的苏家母女。

“瞧，这离王厂长媳妇说苏云如勾引她丈夫才多久，人就又花枝招展的出来了，也是不嫌害臊！”

“嗨，人吃的就是这碗饭，哪是你能比的。当初苏云如丈夫还尸骨未寒呢，她就带着十岁的苏清荔，找了傅大山这个接盘侠。”

“她女儿苏清荔更是青出于蓝胜于蓝，那年她才多大啊？就能撺掇着村支书和王队长家的儿子为了她大打出手。”

“我可听说，市区郑科长的小儿子，已经说过非她不娶，谁敢上门去跟傅家提亲就是跟他过不去呢。”

这话一出，惹得几个树下休息的妇女有些咂舌。

“这有点太霸道了吧？”

“是啊，再怎么着也不能强娶吧？”

闻言，率先提起这个话题的刘嫂子撇了撇嘴，看向苏清荔的目光充满鄙夷。

“过分什么？我就不信要不是苏清荔那丫头主动勾引，人堂堂一个科长儿子会这么说？说到底还是她身上那股子骚劲儿惹来的祸事。”

“行了，她俩快过来了，让人听到不好。”

眼看她说话越来越难听，旁边的人忙示意她闭嘴。

“怕什么？”刘嫂子听到这话，反而越发来劲，大声道，“她这样的还怕人说？”

这样诋毁的话，自苏清荔十年前穿来后，几乎每天都要上演。

原因很简单。

在柳树沟这片贫瘠的土地上，她和苏母都生的太过娇艳。

尽管她俩足够自持，可也挡不住那些狂蜂浪蝶，和街坊邻居的流言蜚语。

她表情淡定，苏母却不能任由别人诋毁女儿。

当即狠狠瞪那人一眼，骂道，“舌头不要就送到卤肉店，在这里装长舌妇，也不怕那天走夜路时绊倒自己？”

“再让我听到你们说我女儿一句坏话，别怪我到村长那里告你们诽谤！”

刘嫂子平日这么嚣张，不过仗着苏云如脾气好，不跟她计较罢了。见她一反常态大发脾气，还要要告自己，气焰顿时消下去，讪讪道，“姐，我不是那意思。”

苏母冷哼一声，不在理会她。

可心里的气，直到自家地里也没散去。

“怎么了？”她刚一来，傅大山就察觉到不对，当即放下手中包子，走到苏云如旁边轻声问，“谁惹你了？”

“还不是那个郑瑞闲，”苏韵如没好气说，“说出那样的话，害得咱家清荔二十五岁还没人敢来提亲。”

提起这件事，傅大山心里也是五味杂陈。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

It’s noon during the autumn harvest season.

Several women took a break from their busy schedule to discuss the mother and daughter of the Su family who came to deliver food.

"Look, the wife of Director Li Wang said that Su Yunru had only been seducing her husband for a long time, and now she is showing off again, and she is not ashamed!"

"Hey, people only eat this bowl of rice. How can you compare with it? When Su Yunru's husband was still dead, she took ten-year-old Su Qingli and found Fu Dashan, the successor."

"Her daughter Su Qingli is even more talented than her peers. How old was she then? She was able to incite the village party secretary and the sons of Captain Wang's family to fight for her."

"I heard that the youngest son of the urban section chief Zheng has already said that he will not marry anyone but her. Anyone who dares to come to propose marriage to the Fu family will be in trouble with him."

As soon as these words came out, several women resting under the trees were a little stunned.

"Isn't this a bit too overbearing?"

"Yes, no matter what, you can't marry by force, right?"

Hearing this, Sister-in-law Liu, who was the first to bring up this topic, curled her lips and looked at Su Qingli with eyes full of contempt.

"What's too much? I don't believe that if that girl Su Qingli hadn't taken the initiative to seduce her, a dignified son of a section chief would have said that? In the end, it was her coquettishness that caused the trouble."

"Okay, they're coming over soon, it's not good for people to hear."

Seeing that her words were getting worse and worse, the people next to her hurriedly told her to shut up.

"What are you afraid of?" When Sister-in-law Liu heard this, she became more and more excited and said loudly, "Is she afraid of people saying this?"

Such slander has been repeated almost every day since Su Qingli came here ten years ago.

The reason is simple.

In the barren land of Liushugou, both she and Su's mother were born too delicately.

Even though they were self-possessed, they couldn't stop the gossips and rumors from their neighbors.

Her expression was calm, but Mother Su could not let others slander her daughter.

He immediately gave the man a hard look and cursed, "If you don't want your tongue, just send it to a braised meat shop and pretend to be a tongue-tied woman here. Aren't you afraid of tripping yourself while walking at night?"

"If I hear you say something bad about my daughter again, don't blame me for going to the village chief to sue you for slander!"

Sister-in-law Liu is usually so arrogant, but she just relies on Su Yunru's good temper and doesn't argue with her.Seeing that she lost her temper uncharacteristically and wanted to sue herself, her arrogance immediately subsided and she said sarcastically, "Sister, I didn't mean that."

Mother Su snorted coldly and ignored her.

But the anger in my heart did not dissipate even in my own land.

"What's wrong?" As soon as she arrived, Fu Dashan noticed something was wrong. He immediately put down the bun in his hand, walked to Su Yunru and asked softly, "Who messed with you?"

"It's not that Zheng Ruixian," Su Yunru said angrily, "Say things like that, and no one in our Qingli family dares to propose marriage even when she is twenty-five years old."

When mentioning this matter, Fu Dashan also had mixed feelings in his heart.
